placed in the screen's own regions, so the

flow() and add()/tail() what the facade placed
after the furniture rather than instead of it,

lines() and share(), where a grid draws Regions side by side
flow the Region's blocks from both ends, scroll if declared

and moved as one, because no Region of it
aborts from anywhere, including an open field
[a button, work to run, leaving, or the wheel]
held here: none of the four acts on a block -
the wheel moves the surface the cursor is on,
region or arrangement, leaving the cursor put
the focused block, if it binds that key
move the cursor, open a field, go into a panel,
come back out, show a field's help
rows that follow the answers re-resolve,
